blocks.text: Transition elements ki pehli row mein titanium se copper tak metals hain. In ke adhoore bhare 3d orbitals ki wajah se in ki kuch mushtarka (common) physical aur chemical properties hain, jo agle topics mein di gayi hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Physical properties (18.2.1): sakht, chamakdar, zyada density aur oonche melting points wali achhi conductor metals. Chemical properties (18.2.2 se 18.2.4): variable oxidation states, complexes, rangeen ions aur catalyst ka kaam.

blocks.prompt: 3d elements ki khaas properties ke zimmedar kaun se electrons hain?
blocks.explanation: Adhoore bhare (partially filled) 3d subshell ke electrons.

items: Pehli row: Ti se Cu; in ki properties adhoore bhare 3d orbitals se aati hain.
